# QR Code generator

Project Nayuki QR Code generator, version 1.8.0, MIT license (included in each
source file). Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/c

Unmodified upstream SHA-256:

- qrcodegen.c: 300eff07ee25baaa7578f20284411638154716379437391e7e689c0e6ce81403
- qrcodegen.h: e82df4bff37d18b5863b9e7486fe6bda1b6cda8c3b9ecebfec473907265cb589

The client uses static caller buffers bounded to QR version 12 and renders
integer-size modules with a four-module quiet border.
